Who we are

A trusted link in the global healthcare chain

Al Qabas Group was established in Muscat in 2012. In 2018 the group extended its activities into the pharmaceutical sector with the launch of Al Qabas Pharmacy L.L.C, a wholesale distributor licensed by the Ministry of Health. Since then the company has built a reliable supply network linking international manufacturers with hospitals, pharmacies and government health bodies across the Middle East and Africa. Led by a management team with more than 30 years of combined industry experience, Al Qabas Pharmacy continues to grow on the principles it was founded on: quality, compliance and long term partnership.

Why Al Qabas

Five reasons healthcare providers rely on us

From a single hard to find molecule to a full hospital department, one partner covers the whole chain.

Comprehensive product portfolio

We import and export a wide spectrum of pharmaceuticals, from branded and generic medicines to vaccines, plus specialised access programmes, reference listed drugs and hard to source medications.

Wide clientele

We serve pharmacies, private hospitals, clinics, government health departments, NGOs, distributors and manufacturers across the Middle East and Africa.

Full scale surgical and medical supplies

Medical devices, lab and surgical consumables, radiology, cardiac implants, diagnostics, environmental disinfection supplies and hospital maintenance services.

Regulatory excellence

Fully licensed and regulated by the Omani Ministry of Health, with robust quality control, strict compliance with international standards and integrity across our supply chain.

Global sourcing expertise

Specialists in international procurement and distribution, including unlicensed and special supply medicines, comparator sourcing for clinical trials and managed access programmes.
